scope: Separate saved-checkpoint visible Editor collaboration. No direct in-memory document mutation, hidden worker startup or universal native acceptance.
sourceFingerprintPolicy: Current Git-normalized UTF-8 LF. Native observations precede only the final added minimap-worker refusal and capability metadata, separately regression-checked; no whole-package native renewal is claimed.

implementation.authoring: Existing public tool schemas and executor in a persistent scoped child project
implementation.handoff: One ordinary WM_DROPFILES request to an existing explicitly bound visible Editor
implementation.checkpointNames: Session identity and revision prevent abbreviated-caption aliases

architecture.scope: Static relative value imports/re-exports after TypeScript type erasure; excludes dynamic imports and external runtimes.

native.transport: Actual outer MCP stdio -> live authoring tool executor -> verified archive exporter -> standard Windows file-drop -> existing visible Editor
native.addedPlacements: Two map-local ArenaPilot Units in the first handoff and one in the final handoff; inspected actual 3D viewport
native.camera: Camera001 created using ordinary visible Editor UI, saved normally, then imported through live.pull

retainedFindings: Initial placement correctly refused absent/undeclared Marine catalog dependencies; final test selected the map-local ArenaPilot rather than changing dependencies to bypass the guard.
The first real handoff returned while the normal load Activity was still open; a later actual viewport confirmed delivery.

Editor abbreviates long paths in GetWindowText itself. A repeated generic checkpoint basename produced an invalid early caption match during a harness attempt. Session-unique checkpoint basenames fixed it; the final handoff submitted normally and its different title was observed.
One new compact lifecycle regression initially failed because the live namespace lacked stage dispatch. The implementation was corrected and all39 final scoped tests passed.
limits: Direct object-by-object in-memory editing and native Undo grouping are not implemented.

Initial document binding uses an explicit saved archive plus exact window/process identity and a full or qualified abbreviated title; it is not an authoritative DLL document-path API. Original archives are never overwritten.
A file-open submission is not native load, compiler or visual proof. Unsupported file-drop windows return a manual-open path.
The actual visual check covers this Terrain viewport and map. This does not renew all Data, GUI, multiplayer, dependency, locale or gameplay acceptance.
Native save uses the original Editor serializer; known inactive-locale preservation findings remain.
Visible native diagnostics/CompileAll were not separately read or executed in this pass. Existing available diagnostic coverage is not upgraded.
Already-running MCP frontends need reconnection to expose the new module. Other chats' Editor workers were not attached to or stopped.
